      CorrEndBimod H H

      A source-generic Boca correspondence wrapper. The only extra datum needed by the CorrEndBimod H H API is the left End H action on the Stinespring carrier. For A = End H this is exactly stinespringReprHom; for A = Fin m -> Complex it is not supplied by Stinespring, whose representation has source Fin m -> Complex.
